chaosVariants.low: Start the day with pan con tomate and café con leche at a local bar.
chaosVariants.medium: Find the place with the longest queue of locals and order whatever everyone else has.
chaosVariants.high: Make your own pan con tomate at a market stall using ingredients you argue-negotiated for.

chaosVariants.low: Walk around the Sagrada Família exterior and spend time with both the Nativity and Passion facades.
chaosVariants.medium: Sketch or photograph only the details that most people walk past.
chaosVariants.high: Ask three strangers to explain what they think Gaudí was trying to say. Compile their answers.

chaosVariants.low: Wander La Boqueria and buy a few things that look beautiful and unusual.
chaosVariants.medium: Build a lunch from three different stalls using a 10€ budget.
chaosVariants.high: Eat only things you've never tasted before for your entire Boqueria visit.

chaosVariants.low: Spend the afternoon at Barceloneta beach — swim, people-watch, do nothing.
chaosVariants.medium: Join whichever beach volleyball game looks the most competitive.
chaosVariants.high: Set a timer for 90 minutes. Do not use your phone once. Just exist at the beach.

activityDeck.baseText: Lunch tapas crawl in El Born

chaosVariants.low: Do a casual tapas crawl through El Born — two or three bars, patatas bravas, croquetas.
chaosVariants.medium: Order one item at each bar and refuse to look at menus — just point at what looks good.
chaosVariants.high: Eat standing at the bar every time. No sitting allowed for the entire crawl.

chaosVariants.low: Book a timed entry to Park Güell's monumental zone and explore the mosaic terraces.
chaosVariants.medium: Skip the main area and explore the free wooded paths and lesser-visited corners.
chaosVariants.high: Find the least photographed spot in the entire park and spend 20 minutes there alone.

chaosVariants.low: Join the Sunday vermouth tradition in the squares of Gràcia with olives and chips.
chaosVariants.medium: Try three different vermouths at three different bars without repeating a snack.
chaosVariants.high: Ask every bar you enter which vermouth is their proudest pour and drink only that.

chaosVariants.low: Walk the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter as the crowds thin and the lights come on.
chaosVariants.medium: Navigate the Gothic Quarter using only right turns for 30 minutes. No left turns allowed.
chaosVariants.high: Find three hidden Roman ruins on foot using no map — only logic and architectural intuition.

chaosVariants.low: Eat a leisurely seafood dinner near the marina — fideuà or fresh grilled fish.
chaosVariants.medium: Let the server order for you based on what came in fresh that day.
chaosVariants.high: Order the entire table sharing menu for yourself. No leftovers allowed.

chaosVariants.low: Watch a flamenco performance at an intimate tablao in El Raval.
chaosVariants.medium: Find a free flamenco performance in a bar or cultural centre rather than a tourist venue.
chaosVariants.high: Stay for the entire night at a bar where flamenco breaks out spontaneously. Do not leave first.
